title: Internship Finder — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Searches for internships in the student's field with fit ranking. The Internship Finder searches for internships in a student's field. It filters listings by major, location, paid vs unpaid, and timing — summer, semester, co-op — then ranks by fit: how well the role matches the student's skills and goals. Deadlines and application requirements are tracked so nothing is missed.
capabilities: Filter by major, location, pay, timing
Rank listings by skill and goal fit
Track deadlines and requirements
Cover summer, semester, and co-op
Show what each role actually involves
